objective: Improve Normal generalization while preserving the RF-v4 controlled HTTP DDoS-like/load improvement and PortScan performance.

session_contract.independence: Three unique, non-overlapping capture sessions with unique IDs, PCAPs, generator logs, extraction outputs, adapted outputs, and lineage.

frozen_workload.execution: sequential; exactly one request at a time
frozen_workload.boundedness_rationale: Three sessions and 300 requests are practical while targeting substantially more benign flows than the 94 Normal rows in the frozen RF-v4 training composition.

future_single_candidate.preprocessing: Exactly the frozen RF-v4 pipeline; no fitting-policy, imputation, threshold, or feature-contract change.
future_single_candidate.evaluation: Evaluate once on the already frozen F4-A2 validation vectors, identically to RF-v2/v3/v4.
future_single_candidate.acceptance_gates: Existing frozen Experiment F validation gates remain mandatory and unchanged.
